5. hF44 (SN38 5FU OXA) — green bar (~230 days), SN38 blue, 5FU blue, OXA gray

8. hF3 (5FU OXA) — orange bar (~150 days), 5FU blue, OXA red
9. hF28 (GEM 5FU) — orange bar (~130 days), GEM gray, 5FU red

So the concordance rule: patient outcome (PFS > median = responder/good; PFS <= median = poor) vs PDO profile.

Therefore headline accuracy = 8/9, with records for the 9 patients: score = PDO-based prediction, truth = clinical outcome (PFS relative to median, or progression status).
